title: The Airlock

characters.name: Kirk
characters.character_description: semi-realistic Pixar 3D Captain James T. Kirk, athletic build, light brown hair swept to side, strong jaw, confident commanding expression, gold-yellow TOS Starfleet command tunic with delta badge, upper body portrait
characters.status: EP4: Confirmed Spock as the watcher. Learned from Spock that Scotty armed the weapons array and is on the bridge. Left Chekov under Worf's guard and sprinted alone toward the bridge with ~2 minutes before weapons fire.

relationships.Worf: uneasy alliance — Worf told the truth at great personal cost
relationships.Chekov: still fighting for him — refusing to abandon the mission

characters.name: Worf
characters.character_description: semi-realistic Pixar 3D Commander Worf, imposing Klingon-Human, prominent forehead ridges, dark skin, fierce disciplined expression, TNG Starfleet command red uniform with lieutenant commander pips, broad shoulders, intense dark eyes
characters.status: EP4: Lowered phaser when the watcher revealed himself as Spock. Now guarding Chekov in the airlock chamber — Kirk's direct order: 'No one in or out.' Waiting while Kirk goes to the bridge alone.

relationships.Kirk: bound together now — shared knowledge of Section 31 = shared death sentence

characters.name: Chekov
characters.character_description: semi-realistic Pixar 3D Ensign Pavel Chekov, young face, distinctive bowl-cut dark hair, wide fearful eyes, pale skin, TOS gold Starfleet uniform, panicked desperate expression
characters.status: EP4: Still slumped in the airlock chamber. Witnessed Spock arrive and deliver intel. Last seen barely conscious, under Worf's guard. Knows who the mole is but has not been further questioned.

relationships.Kirk: trusts captain completely — begged for help

characters.name: Spock
characters.character_description: semi-realistic Pixar 3D Commander Spock, pointed Vulcan ears, sharply arched thick eyebrows, straight black bowl-cut hair, olive-tinted skin, calm emotionless expression with one eyebrow slightly raised, blue TOS science tunic with black collar and Starfleet delta badge, hands clasped behind back
characters.status: EP4: Revealed as the watcher. Was running a Section 31 counter-operation. Gave Kirk the intel on Scotty and the weapons lock. Remained behind in the corridor after Kirk sprinted to the bridge.

relationships.Kirk: deep bond — acts independently but always in Kirk's interests
relationships.Worf: neutral — Worf accepted his identity without conflict

episode_summaries.summary: Worf leads Chekov to the airlock on Fleet Admiral's orders. Kirk commands Worf to stand down — refused. Worf claims the order was signed personally by the Fleet Admiral. Kirk and Worf watch the airlock seal. Chekov screams it's a setup from behind the glass. Kirk asks: 'Worf. Who really gave you that order.' Worf drops his eyes. Silence.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Worf knows who really gave the order — and it wasn't the Fleet Admiral

episode_summaries.summary: Worf breaks silence — reveals Section 31 gave the kill order. Kirk denies it ('That's a ghost story'). Worf produces PADD with Fleet Admiral's personal seal. Kirk goes ice-cold: 'The order. Show me.' Worf: 'Now you see, Captain. We are both dead.' The airlock door SWITCHES from SEALED to UNLOCKED by itself — nobody touched it. Kirk and Worf both stare.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Someone has remote control of the ship. Nobody authorized the unlock. The door is open.

episode_summaries.summary: Worf grabs Kirk — warns the watcher is still active. Kirk walks through anyway: 'Then they're watching me walk through it.' Worf draws phaser, holds the doorway. Kirk finds Chekov alive inside the airlock chamber, slumped against the wall. Chekov delivers his bombshell: 'it's someone on your crew.' Behind them: Worf spots a silhouette figure at the far corridor junction — motionless, arm raised, pointing at Kirk. Worf's phaser swings toward it. Standoff.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: A figure in Starfleet uniform stands at the corridor end pointing at Kirk. It doesn't move. It doesn't run. Who is the mole — and is this figure ally or assassin?

episode_summaries.summary: The watcher walks forward into the red alert light — it's Spock. Worf lowers his phaser. Spock tells Kirk the weapons array was armed six minutes ago and Scotty is on the bridge. Two minutes left. Kirk orders Worf to guard Chekov and sprints alone toward the bridge.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Exterior shot: Enterprise weapons array locks on an allied Starfleet escort vessel. Amber targeting reticle confirmed. Kirk is still running.
